invention.test: const {sim,world,RAPIER}=game;const near=game.entities.find(e=>e.id==='near-bank'),far=game.entities.find(e=>e.id==='far-bank');assert(near&&far,'Two banks exist');const edge=near.position.x+near.half.x,other=far.position.x-far.half.x,mid=(edge+other)/2;sim.player.setTranslation({x:edge-1,y:.8,z:0},true);sim.player.setLinvel({x:0,y:0,z:0},true);sim.manual={x:0,y:0,z:0};sim.aim={x:1,y:0,z:0};advance(2);function support(){return world.castRay(new RAPIER.Ray({x:mid,y:.5,z:0},{x:0,y:-1,z:0}),1,true,undefined,undefined,undefined,sim.player);}assert(!support(),'Gap initially has no support');behavior.use();advance(10);assert(!support(),'Growth takes time to reach the gap center');advance(200);assert(!!support(),'Grown bridge has physical support over the void');let leaves=0;game.root.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.geometry.type==='SphereGeometry'&&o.scale.z>.5)leaves++;});assert(leaves>5,'Leaves have sprouted along the bridge');sim.manual={x:2,y:0,z:0};advance(90);sim.manual={x:0,y:0,z:0};advance(25);assert(sim.position.x>edge&&sim.position.x<other&&sim.position.y>.65,'Player can stand physically supported over the gap');sim.manual={x:2,y:0,z:0};advance(95);sim.manual={x:0,y:0,z:0};advance(15);assert(sim.position.x>other&&sim.position.y>.65,'Player walks across to the far bank');behavior.use();advance(210);assert(!support(),'Retraction removes physical bridge support');behavior.use();advance(210);assert(!!support(),'Vine can regrow after retracting');
invention.name: Living Vine Bridge
invention.description: A woven bridge of living vines grows from the near bank to the far bank, unfurling leaves and forming a solid walking surface. Press again and it withdraws.
invention.usage: Press F to grow the leafy path across the broken bridge. Wait for it to reach the far bank, then walk across. Press F again to retract; pressing during growthes
limitations: Growth takes roughly three seconds; unfinished tips are not yet load-bearing.
Retraction removes support from the far end first, so step onto a bank before retracting.
The bridge follows the center of the broken crossing and has no guardrails.
